mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS "userId", USER_NAME AS "userName", PASSWORD_ENC AS "passwordEnc", USE_YN AS "useYn", PW_CHANGE_YN AS "pwChangeYn", LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT AS "loginFailCount" FROM ${tp}user WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE ${tp}user
SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN_AT = now()
SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.AUTH_ID AS "authId", A.ADMIN_YN AS "adminYn" FROM ${tp}group_user GU JOIN ${tp}group_auth GA ON GA.GROUP_ID = GU.GROUP_ID JOIN ${tp}auth A ON A.AUTH_ID = GA.AUTH_ID WHERE GU.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT M.MENU_ID FROM ${tp}menu M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (M.ALL_USERS_YN = 'Y' OR M.MENU_ID IN (SELECT AM.MENU_ID FROM ${tp}auth_menu AM JOIN ${tp}group_auth GA ON GA.AUTH_ID = AM.AUTH_ID JOIN ${tp}group_user GU ON GU.GROUP_ID = GA.GROUP_ID WHERE GU.USER_ID = #{userId}))

SELECT U.USER_ID AS "userId", U.USER_NAME AS "userName", U.USE_YN AS "useYn", U.PW_CHANGE_YN AS "pwChangeYn", U.LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT AS "loginFailCount", U.LAST_LOGIN_AT AS "lastLoginAt", U.UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt", COALESCE((SELECT STRING_AGG(GU.GROUP_ID, ',' ORDER BY GU.GROUP_ID) FROM ${tp}group_user GU WHERE GU.USER_ID = U.USER_ID), '') AS "groupIds" FROM ${tp}user U ORDER BY U.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tp}user (USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD_ENC, USE_YN, PW_CHANGE_YN, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{passwordEnc}, #{useYn}, 'Y', 0, now(), #{by}, now(), #{by})
mapper.select: SELECT G.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", G.GROUP_NAME AS "groupName", G.DESCRIPTION AS "description", G.SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${tp}group_user GU WHERE GU.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID) AS "userCount", COALESCE((SELECT STRING_AGG(GA.AUTH_ID, ',' ORDER BY GA.AUTH_ID) FROM ${tp}group_auth GA WHERE GA.GROUP_ID = G.GROUP_ID), '') AS "authIds" FROM ${tp}group G ORDER BY G.SORT_ORDER, G.GROUP_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tp}group (GROUP_ID, GROUP_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (GROUP_ID) DO UPDATE SET GROUP_NAME = EXCLUDED.GROUP_NAME, DESCRIPTION = EXCLUDED.DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER = EXCLUDED.SORT_ORDER, UPDATED_AT = now()
mapper.select: SELECT A.AUTH_ID AS "authId", A.AUTH_NAME AS "authName", A.DESCRIPTION AS "description", A.ADMIN_YN AS "adminYn", A.SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", COALESCE((SELECT STRING_AGG(AM.MENU_ID, ',' ORDER BY AM.MENU_ID) FROM ${tp}auth_menu AM WHERE AM.AUTH_ID = A.AUTH_ID), '') AS "menuIds" FROM ${tp}auth A ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER, A.AUTH_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tp}auth (AUTH_ID, AUTH_NAME, DESCRIPTION, ADMIN_YN, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{authId}, #{authName}, #{description}, #{adminYn}, #{sortOrder}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (AUTH_ID) DO UPDATE SET AUTH_NAME = EXCLUDED.AUTH_NAME, DESCRIPTION = EXCLUDED.DESCRIPTION, ADMIN_YN = EXCLUDED.ADMIN_YN, SORT_ORDER = EXCLUDED.SORT_ORDER, UPDATED_AT = now()
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID AS "menuId", PARENT_ID AS "parentId", MENU_NAME AS "menuName", URL AS "url", ICON AS "icon", SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", USE_YN AS "useYn", ALL_USERS_YN AS "allUsersYn" FROM ${tp}menu ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, MENU_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tp}menu (MENU_ID, PARENT_ID, MENU_NAME, URL, ICON, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, ALL_USERS_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{url}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{useYn}, #{allUsersYn}, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (MENU_ID) DO UPDATE SET PARENT_ID = EXCLUDED.PARENT_ID, MENU_NAME = EXCLUDED.MENU_NAME, URL = EXCLUDED.URL, ICON = EXCLUDED.ICON, SORT_ORDER = EXCLUDED.SORT_ORDER, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, ALL_USERS_YN = EXCLUDED.ALL_USERS_YN, UPDATED_AT = now()
